milestones.title: M1 - Works on eduroam
milestones.description: A small live room works for 30 devices on eduroam in a real classroom.

milestones.title: M2 - Playable
milestones.description: One full class can play the Black Friday scenario from join to finish screen.

milestones.title: M3 - Pilot class
milestones.description: Ready for a pilot with a real class and teacher: debrief, teacher control, export, accessibility.

milestones.title: M4 - Version 1
milestones.description: Teacher kit complete and a second scenario, ready for regular teaching.

issues.title: Set up the TypeScript project: app, room server and shared game rules
issues.body:
**As a** developer, **I want** one project with the app, the session room and shared game rules, **so that** the same rules run in the browser and on the server.

**Done when**
- [ ] `npm install` and `npm run dev` start the app and a local room
- [ ] Folders: `app/`, `room/`, `shared/`
- [ ] README explains how to run it

Part of: **Foundations** · Concept book board 15
